newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Healthdyne Q2 seen strong.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Healthdyne Q2 seen strong.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc shares could be hurt as takeover players head for the doors after some court news, but the company's second quarter earnings could beat Wall Street expectations, Dillon Read analysts said.
-- On Thursday, a U.S. district court refused to throw out the company's "poison pill" shareholder rights plan as requested by Invacare Corp, which has launched a $200 million bid for Healthdyne.

-- Dillon Read's Matthew Dodds and Raul Esquivel said: "Some investors that are only playing the story for a near-term takover will be disappointed in Thursday's decision and opt to dump some shares."

-- They maintained a buy rating, saying Healthdyne will continue exploring alternatives to Invacare's $15 a share bid and said Healthdyne should report "very strong" Q2 earnings in the next seven-10 days.

-- Said they think Healthdyne will post revenue growth over 25 percent. EPS could grow more than 70 percent, beating their estimate of $0.17 compared with $0.10 a share last year. The earnings would also be without any of the "trickery" that has been suggested by Invacare, they said.
-- Shares rose 1/2 to 17-1/8 in early trading.
